requirements.text: Change nothing else in apps/bayes-group-site beyond the three fixes.
Every existing acceptance test keeps passing, except where this task changes that behavior.
On desktop, the footer no longer shows the extra unlabeled column of links (Services, Systems, Training, Engagements, About, Contact) at the right.
On phones, the footer no longer shows the extra unlabeled column of links (Services, Systems, Training, Engagements, About, Contact).
The footer contains exactly three groups.
The first footer group shows the wordmark, the text "AI enablement, training and custom development." and the email.
The footer has a "Services" column with the links AI Enablement, Training, Custom Development, Systems engineering and Engagements.
The footer has a "Company" column with the links About and Contact.
The footer ends with the bottom line "© 2026 The Bayes Group".
On desktop, the three footer groups sit in one row, with the wordmark group wider and on the left.
On phones, the three footer groups stack vertically.
The /contact page has a navy page header band like the other inner pages (Services, Systems, Training, Engagements, About).
The contact header band has the data-grid motif on its navy background.
The contact header shows the small uppercase teal eyebrow "CONTACT".
The contact header shows the h1 "Book a consultation" in white.
Under the h1, the contact header shows the lead "Tell us what you're working on and we'll reply within one business day."
Under the lead, the contact header shows "Prefer email? hello@thebayesgroup.com".
The email hello@thebayesgroup.com in the contact header stays a mailto link.
The email link in the contact header is readable on the navy background.
Below the contact header, the two-column form and the "What happens next" card appear on the page's normal background with the usual section spacing.
The contact form and the "What happens next" card are otherwise unchanged.
On desktop, the /systems hero shows the heading and lead sentence in the left column, about 40% of the width.
On desktop, the /systems hero shows the architecture diagram in the right column beside the text, vertically centered, instead of below the text.
On phones, the /systems hero architecture diagram stays below the text.
Keep the architecture diagram's content and labels exactly as they are.

R18.test: contact page header band > band holds the eyebrow, h1, lead and email line, and no form
